purpose: Recover the interrupted exact-crown baseline and collect one current-crown sampled profile before choosing any source candidate.

compute.rate_source: AWS Price List API, Linux shared on-demand, US East Ohio

jobs.name: fixed-seed-system-profile
jobs.result: proof hash, perf.data hash, elapsed time, sampled symbols, and lost-event count

stop_rules: Stop immediately if the crown or worker identity differs.
Stop if another benchmark or build process is active on the host.
Stop on any proof mismatch, missing output, profiler error, or nonzero lost-sample signal.
Stop before the additional 15-minute or USD 0.1785 cap.
Stop the instance after artifacts are recovered, regardless of outcome.
